donor.normalization: UTF-8 decoded, CRLF normalized to LF

policy.ripe: Preserve until explicit harvest/removal, irrespective of elapsed minutes.
policy.growing: Advance production growth stages until first ripe stage; no elapsed-time decay or cycling.
policy.gardening: No per-minute moisture, weeds or pests simulation for Johto.
policy.host: All other IDs retain host timer, gardening, decay and OW_BERRY_IMMORTAL behavior.

adaptations: Johto-only range gate preserves host BerryTreeGrow and host crop policies.
Stop immediately on maturity to bound work to the remaining growth stages.
No new save fields, old-save migration or harvest API dependency.

verification.python: Source/provenance assertions only; not runtime proof.
verification.engine_execution: Owned by root; not executed by implementer.
